title: Soma Core JSON boundary
description: Owned by soma. Wire shapes and current operations only; platform dependencies and sync policy are implemented in TypeScript.

skippedTables.description: Tables skipped in the last completed pull round, including rounds with rejected pushes. Empty when no skip history is stored; not a coverage or freshness certificate.

SearchIndexStepArgs.description: budgetMs: milliseconds of indexing work before returning (default 50); at least one chunk always runs.

SearchIndexStatus.description: pending counts rows still waiting to be indexed.

indexing.description: Rows still wait to be indexed; search and backlinks may be incomplete.

done.description: No work is left, including removing entries of tables that left the index. Hosts call again until true.

SearchExclusion.description: Why the index leaves a table out by default: provenance edges repeat other rows' identities; size means more rows than the sync size rule allows.

SearchTable.description: A catalogued table with text properties the search index can hold. rows: records, from sync's hub counts when stored, else counted locally. textBytes: estimated bytes of text its index entries hold, from a sample of rows.

indexed.description: Whether the index holds (or is building) this table's entries now.

defaultExclusion.description: Null when the table is indexed by default.

override.description: This device's choice: true indexes it anyway, false leaves it out, null follows the default.

SearchTableList.description: sizeLimit: rows above which a table is left out by default (the sync size rule).

indexed.description: true or false overrides the default for this table; null returns it to the default.

dayStartMinutes.description: Version 2 host calendar policy: integer minutes after local midnight, 0 through 1439. Omitted means 0. Applied with timeZone to runtime CalendarContext, never persisted as resolved timestamps.

wrap.description: Version 2 presentation: distinct catalogued columns whose cells wrap their full text. Omitted means no column wraps.

SavedViewDefinition.description: columns is SQL projection and may omit id, updated_at and hidden fields; fetch a full row before editing. For visible layout only, omit columns when querying rows.

ListViewsArgs.description: Omitting table lists live saved views of every table, ordered by table then name.

SaveViewArgs.description: expectedUpdatedAt is required when id is supplied; omit both to create a new view.

Writeability.description: Advisory table guards only. writeRow rechecks under its writer transaction; coverage is not a simultaneous or current remote snapshot.

RemoteRecord.description: Transient read-only hub row, including all locally known physical columns. deleted explicitly identifies tombstones. Never pass this record to the local writer or imply it is locally replicated.

RemoteRowsArgs.description: One online page in source ID order; default limit 50, maximum 200. Pass nextCursor unchanged; omit cursor to refresh. No text search, arbitrary filters, sorting, count or snapshot guarantee.

RemoteRowsPage.description: Transient page including tombstones. A full page may require an empty terminal request. Across a changing hub, clients deduplicate repeated record IDs before keyed rendering, replacing the displayed record with the later response; this does not establish a snapshot.

RemoteRowArgs.description: One online ID lookup using the source column collation; the returned ID retains its stored spelling.

UndoAction.description: One volatile last saved change in this opened workspace session. receiptId is opaque; clients never supply inverse data. Each autosave replaces the previous action.

SessionReply.description: Host supplies HTTP status, bounded parsed JSON on 200 or null otherwise. Never derive status from error strings. Optional Retry-After delay is parsed by the host without platform clocks in core.

EnrollmentPollResult.description: Approved means the candidate identity was authenticated. Hosts must also require session.replica.allowed before installing it for replica use. Pending never distinguishes an unapproved token from a revoked one.

SessionRevocationResult.description: Unauthorized is not proof that an unregistered approval URL has been cancelled; a later browser approval remains possible.

RejectedEdit.description: Durable submitted snapshot and unchanged hub rejection objects, not the current local row. IDs preserve exact string bytes. Re-read a full local row and use its current revision before repair; only accepted sync receipts clear the inbox.

RejectionsArgs.description: Offset pagination over the current local inbox, ordered by binary table and row ID. Default limit 100, maximum 200; default offset 0. Restart at offset 0 after sync changes the inbox; pages are not a cross-request snapshot.

HubSession.description: Wire session identity. Absent capabilities are legacy only; explicit capabilities require schema full-ddl-v1 and replica_sync true before replica enrollment. Consumer enrollment still rejects admin credentials.

ScopedReplicaUnsupported.description: HTTP 403. Canonical message and response fixture: tests/fixtures/hub-capabilities-contract.json.

expectedViewUpdatedAt.description: Revision of the saved-view definition displayed for this action. Checked atomically with the selected row revision.

CellValue.description: Typed stored cell value; integer strings preserve signed 64-bit precision. Unknown history is an outer null, distinct from a null cell.

Preview.description: Authenticated inert service preview. Its opaque token binds exact validated evidence and does not grant authority.

MutationResolution.description: Original-operation settlement, not the outcome of one HTTP attempt. not_committed requires a durable server record preventing this exact key/request from ever applying; other rejections remain unresolved.

TransportError.description: Adapter outcome, not a service JSON response. Preserve the exact original mutation request and key on uncertain delivery.

ResolveDerivedArgs.description: Resolve one saved derived property on the bound hub, requiring the displayed row revision. Never accepts draft values or locally computes metadata.

ViewPresentation.description: Version 2 display settings, independent of SQL projection. Calendar uses a start date and optional inclusive end-date column. Board groups by a select property. Gallery uses an optional cover property.

ReadPlanGuard.description: Exact ordered SQL rows are collision-free structural fingerprints. Hosts compare scalar values and UTF-8 strings exactly in the same read transaction as execution; never trust metadata alone.

file.description: Opaque host file reference; the host opens it and removes gzip.

recovery.description: Opaque host destination for the recovery dump of the current replica, written before anything is replaced.

confirm.description: Typed by the user in the app before applying.

BackupSummary.description: Ordinary tables only; underscore plumbing and device sync state are never part of a dump.

MentionLabel.description: label is null when the exact record or its table is unavailable; hosts then show the stored link text as unavailable.

indexing.description: Rows still wait for the search index step, so the list may be missing recent mentions.

ViewEmbed.description: Read-only preview rows projected to id plus the displayed columns. calendar asks the host to repeat the request with that policy's CalendarContext.

catalogRevision.description: Changes whenever any catalog row changes; compare before re-reading the whole catalog.

rows.description: columns is SQL projection and may omit id, updated_at and hidden fields; fetch a full row before editing. For visible layout only, omit columns when querying rows.

searchIndexStep.description: Builds and maintains the local search and backlink index in one bounded transaction: indexes rows changed since the last call, backfills newly indexed tables and removes tables that left it. Provenance and tables over the sync size rule are skipped unless `_core_state` key `search_tables` opts them in. Search and backlinks never build the index themselves.

searchTables.description: Read-only: every table the search index can hold, whether it is indexed and why, its records and an estimate of its text, for a host's settings. Never builds or reconciles the index.

setSearchTable.description: Stores this device's choice for one table in `_core_state` `search_tables` and returns the updated list. Hosts then schedule `searchIndexStep`, which backfills a table that joined the index and removes the entries of one that left it.

listViews.description: columns is SQL projection and may omit id, updated_at and hidden fields; fetch a full row before editing. For visible layout only, omit columns when querying rows.

saveView.description: expectedUpdatedAt is required when id is supplied; omit both to create a new view.

writeability.description: Read-only advisory. Always use write for the transactionally rechecked mutation.

remoteRows.description: One bounded hub pull with no local row, checkpoint, coverage or outbox writes. A matching durable endpoint binding and local schema are required. Remote results are read-only.

remoteRow.description: One bounded hub pull by ID; null means no matching row. Tombstones remain explicit. A matching durable endpoint binding and local schema are required.

undoStatus.description: Read this handler instance's last saved change after queued session mutations settle. Closing the workspace discards the receipt. This is not a history query or a guarantee that undo will pass current validation.

undo.description: Undo last saved change through the ordinary validated writer, requiring the captured revision and shape. Success consumes the receipt; failure preserves it. No redo or timestamp restoration. Hosts pause autosave and preserve newer drafts for explicit review.

enrollmentApproval.description: Pure relative approval path and public fingerprint code. Hosts validate/canonicalize the endpoint and generate/hash the candidate token; core never receives it.

validateDeviceSession.description: Pure nonadmin identity validation and current full-scope replica eligibility. Dedicated manual names are allowed. No network or storage.

enrollmentPollResult.description: Pure classification of one bounded session response, matching device:<fingerprint> only on approval. Hosts own deadline/cancellation and cap the returned retry delay to remaining time; never poll after the deadline.

sessionRevocationResult.description: Pure classification of session POST. Only 200 with logged_out true confirms revocation; 401 is separately unauthorized, never proof that future approval is impossible.

referenceSources.description: Incoming live catalog ref/multi_ref definitions and persisted skipped-source warnings; no source row scans. Hosts load groups lazily.

referencedBy.description: One bounded local incoming-reference group. Default 20 rows, maximum 100, live sources only. Target identity uses its primary-key collation, including trashed targets. Hosts ignore stale replies and re-read a row before opening it.

rejections.description: Read the durable local rejection inbox without initialization or mutation. Missing storage is empty; malformed persisted data fails the whole page without skipping or deleting entries. An unchanged inbox has exact terminal detection, including a full final page.

resolveSourceLink.description: Resolve supported external source URLs through live whole-record imported_from provenance. Missing mappings remain external; ambiguous identities fail. Hosts re-resolve the destination before guarded navigation.

historyEvents.description: Calls only an explicitly injected, capability-validated governance adapter. Unconfigured handlers remain unavailable; no local writer fallback.

previewChanges.description: Calls only an explicitly injected, capability-validated governance adapter. Unconfigured handlers remain unavailable; no local writer fallback.

createProposal.description: Calls only an explicitly injected, capability-validated governance adapter. Unconfigured handlers remain unavailable; no local writer fallback.

listProposals.description: Calls only an explicitly injected, capability-validated governance adapter. Unconfigured handlers remain unavailable; no local writer fallback.

getProposal.description: Calls only an explicitly injected, capability-validated governance adapter. Unconfigured handlers remain unavailable; no local writer fallback.

editProposal.description: Calls only an explicitly injected, capability-validated governance adapter. Unconfigured handlers remain unavailable; no local writer fallback.

previewProposal.description: Calls only an explicitly injected, capability-validated governance adapter. Unconfigured handlers remain unavailable; no local writer fallback.

approveProposal.description: Calls only an explicitly injected, capability-validated governance adapter. Unconfigured handlers remain unavailable; no local writer fallback.

rejectProposal.description: Calls only an explicitly injected, capability-validated governance adapter. Unconfigured handlers remain unavailable; no local writer fallback.

resolveDerived.description: Request hub-owned derivation for an unchanged saved row. Hosts retain drafts, then sync and re-read the record; this operation never writes replica values.

calendarRows.description: Lay out already loaded rows using host-supplied civil-day bounds. All-day end dates are inclusive; timed ends exclusive, with equal start/end treated as an instant. No query, write or timezone engine.

boardRows.description: Group already loaded rows by a select property, preserving supplied option order and unknown stored values. No writes.

ensureDefaultView.description: Plain table navigation. Without an available preference, creates or restores the deterministic catalog-default saved view and points an absent or cleared preference at it; unavailable preferences keep their row and notice. No Undo receipt and no provisioning.

prepareReadPlan.description: Prepare a bounded read-only title-list or capped-count plan from the canonical compiler. No FTS, schema initialization, or query execution. Host owns stable workspace/replica identity, coherent publication, read-only work budget and exact guards in one read transaction.

saveCatalogProperty.description: Explicit catalog mutation with the displayed revision; commits metadata and catalog_log together. Ordinary record writes remain read-only for catalog tables.

saveCatalogRule.description: Explicit catalog mutation with the displayed revision; commits metadata and catalog_log together. Ordinary record writes remain read-only for catalog tables.

validateBackup.description: Checks the dump shape, format version, schema log and row counts without touching the replica.

restoreReplica.description: Writes the recovery dump, then replaces every ordinary table and the schema log in one transaction and resets device sync state.

exportReplica.description: Streams the portable SQL dump (the soma export shape) to a host destination.

mentionLabels.description: Live display labels for iris://table/<table>/row/<id> mentions, at most 200 exact identities per request.

mentionedBy.description: Live records whose Markdown properties mention this exact record, from the local derived mentions index. Default 20, maximum 100, ordered by table and label.

viewEmbed.description: A bounded read-only preview of one saved view for iris://table/<table>/view/<id> embeds. Default 10 rows, maximum 50.
